test_name: Verify Navigation Between Tabs and Analysis Page
description: This test ensures seamless navigation between the 'RoostGPT', 'Connectors', and 'Analysis' tabs to confirm proper functionality and URL handling.
steps: Open the primary dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
Click on the 'RoostGPT' tab using the selector [data-testid="roostGPT-tab"].
Verify that the 'RoostGPT' page loads successfully.
Click on the 'Connectors' tab using the selector [data-testid="connectors-tab"].
Validate the URL changes to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/connectors.
Click on the 'Analysis' link using the selector //a[@href='/roostgpt/analyses' and contains(@class, 'headerButton_collabButton__1E3Qx')].
Confirm the URL changes to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/analyses.
Verify visible content matches the 'Analysis' page description.
expected_results: Navigation between tabs and pages functions correctly.
URLs update accurately based on user interaction.
Content on each page loads as expected.
edge_cases: Attempt to click tabs repeatedly to check for UI glitches.
Navigate to tabs with slow network conditions.
Access tabs without being logged in (if applicable).
Click tabs while the page is still loading.
Test for proper focus management after navigation for accessibility.
dependencies: The 'Analysis' link must work as expected.
api_interactions: API calls to load data for each tab.
API calls to fetch real-time data for the 'Analysis' page.
performance_metrics: Evaluate content loading time for each tab.
Monitor API response time during navigation.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure keyboard navigation is supported for tab switching.
Verify each tab is labeled appropriately for screen readers.
Confirm focus state is visually distinguishable.
